summary: Israeli Police Gideonim Unit 33 killed Palestinian terrorist Saher Nidal Saqr, a participant in the October 7 abduction of Noa Argamani and Avinatan Or, in a targeted strike in Nuseirat, central Gaza. Hezbollah launched an explosive drone at Israeli troops in the southern Lebanon buffer zone, prompting IDF retaliatory strikes on multiple Hezbollah drone and anti-tank missile launch sites. Saudi Arabia conducted 26 F-15 airstrikes across five Yemeni provinces from Khamis Mushait base, causing dozens of civilian casualties and bringing total strikes since escalation to 1,085.

sections.executive_summary: Israeli security forces eliminated Saher Nidal Saqr, a key participant in the October 7 abduction of Noa Argamani and Avinatan Or, via a Police Gideonim Unit 33 strike in Nuseirat, central Gaza, where he was actively supplying weapons to Hamas and coordinating attacks with Hamas and Islamic Jihad. Simultaneously, Hezbollah launched an explosive drone targeting Israeli troops in the southern Lebanon buffer zone, triggering IDF airstrikes on multiple Hezbollah drone and anti-tank missile launch positions. Regionally, Saudi Arabia intensified its Yemen campaign with 26 F-15 strikes across five provinces, while Iran-US diplomatic talks were reportedly cancelled and Netanyahu departed for UAE meetings.
